# Dia Browser release notes — captured 2026-08-14
# https://diabrowser.com/release-notes

**Fourth consecutive scan with no extractable feature content.**

The index exposes only dates, issue numbers and version strings; each release body is rendered
client-side on a per-newsletter page that WebFetch cannot reach. This scan the newest row is dated
**August 13, 2026 11:15 AM ET** but its Issue No. and App Version fields contain only repeated-digit
placeholder strings, exactly as the three August 6 rows did on 2026-08-10.

Last rows with plausible real values:
  Aug 6, '26  — No. 036, v1.43.1
  Jul 30, '26 — No. 035, v1.42.0
  Jul 23, '26 — No. 034, v1.41.0
The page advertises "DiaWeeklyUnfiltered — New features every week" and "Notes from the roadmap",
so releases are shipping; the monitor simply cannot read them.

WebSearch again returned no feature detail for the August releases.

**No capability confirmed. Nothing reported for Dia for a fourth consecutive scan (since
2026-07-07).** If Dia matters to Zenity, this source needs a different acquisition method — the
per-issue newsletter pages or an RSS feed — rather than the index.
